The cross delivers a uniquely contrasting flavor profile that blends sweet dessert character with savory backbone — producing dense, structurally premium buds with deep color expression and serious bag appeal. Effects BOLO Runtz delivers a comfortable, indica-leaning experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with relaxing body effects. The high lands steadily and lasts — suitable for late-afternoon use, evening unwinding, or any moment where flavor character paired with real depth is the appeal. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet biscotti-cookie up front, with savory undertones through the middle and a creamy cake finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably contrasting. The terpene profile reads sweet-and-savory-cream — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every BOLO Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the BOLO Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms BOLO Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. effects_provenance.raw: Lemon Cherry Belts THCA Flower Preferred / 28g Strain Profile Lemon Cherry Belts THCA Flower is a hybrid bred from Lemon Cherry Gelato crossed with Rainbow Belts . The cross delivers a flavor experience like walking through a sun-drenched orchard with a candy stand at the end — sweet, tangy, layered, and unmistakable. The buds run colorful with strong trichome coverage and high bag appeal. Effects Lemon Cherry Belts delivers a balanced experience that pairs the uplifting cerebral euphoria of Lemon Cherry Gelato with the mellow, easy relaxation Rainbow Belts is known for. The high feels mood-lifting and steady — suitable for daytime use, social settings, or evening wind-down without leaning hard in either direction. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: zesty lemon and sweet cherry up front, with a sugary candy-belt middle and a clean fruit-finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably dessert-and-candy. The terpene profile reads citrus-cherry with sugar accents — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Lemon Cherry Belts harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Lemon Cherry Belts THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Lemon Cherry Belts THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest.
